Package Data

Class Table_Repository

java.lang.Object
Data.Table_Repository
public class Table_Repository extends Object
Repository class for managing Table data and simulating seating capacity. Supports "Soft Delete" functionality by marking tables as inactive instead of removing them from the database, and provides a simulation engine for capacity validation.

  • Method Details

    • getInstance

      public static Table_Repository getInstance()
      Retrieves the singleton instance of the Table_Repository.
      Returns:
      The active Table_Repository instance.

    • init

      public void init()
      Initializes the restaurant table configuration by loading ONLY active tables (IsActive = 1) from the database. This ensures that deactivated tables are excluded from the GUI and memory-based capacity calculations. Updates the Restaurant singleton cache and tracks the largest table size.

    • deleteById

      public boolean deleteById(int tableNumber)
      Performs a "Soft Delete" on a table by updating its status to inactive (0) in the database. After a successful update, it reloads the internal cache to reflect the change immediately.
      Parameters:
      tableNumber - The logical number of the table to deactivate.
      Returns:
      true if the deactivation was successful, false otherwise.

    • isCapacityAvailable

      public boolean isCapacityAvailable(LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end, int guests, Integer excludeId)
      Performs an advanced capacity check for a specific time slot and group size. Uses a simulation that considers existing overlapping reservations and only active tables.
      Parameters:
      start - Starting time of the requested slot.
      end - Ending time of the requested slot.
      guests - Number of diners in the current request.
      excludeId - Optional reservation ID to ignore (used when updating an existing reservation).
      Returns:
      true if there is enough physical capacity to accommodate all groups in that slot.

    • findBestAvailableTable

      public Integer findBestAvailableTable(LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end, int guests)
      Finds the best physical table ID for a specific time slot based on group size. Prioritizes the smallest available active table that fits the group (Best Fit strategy).
      Parameters:
      start - Starting time.
      end - Ending time.
      guests - Group size.
      Returns:
      The database ID of the best available table, or null if no table is available.

    • getOverlappingReservationsList

      public List<Reservation> getOverlappingReservationsList(LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end, Integer excludeId)
      Retrieves all reservations that overlap with a given time range and are not cancelled.
      Parameters:
      start - The start time of the range.
      end - The end time of the range.
      excludeId - An optional ID to exclude (e.g., the reservation being modified).
      Returns:
      A list of overlapping Reservation objects.

    • findImpactedReservations

      public List<Reservation> findImpactedReservations(Restaurant_Table targetTable, boolean isDeleteOperation)
      Identifies reservations that will be negatively impacted if a table is modified or deleted. Runs a "Before vs After" simulation to determine which groups would become "homeless" due to the proposed table change.
      Parameters:
      targetTable - The table being modified or deleted.
      isDeleteOperation - Set to true if simulating a deletion, false for an update.
      Returns:
      A list of Reservations that would no longer fit in the restaurant after the change.
